findings.evidence: Line 80 `norm : g n n = 1`; `Real.div_sqrt`/`Real.sqrt_one` make all four statements collapse. The file works around the missing normal form at lines 120, 127-128, 138-139, 146-151, 182, 191 (`have hn : g F.n F.n = 1 := F.norm`, six times).
findings.fix: State the normal forms: `energy_apply : F.energy p = g p F.n`, `energy_n : F.energy F.n = 1`, `spatial_apply : F.spatial p = p - F.energy p • F.n`, `energy_smul_add_spatial : F.energy p • F.n + F.spatial p = p`, and drop the `(√(g F.n F.n))⁻¹` factor from the `energy` body (line 91). Add `attribute [simp] Frame.norm` so `g F.n F.n` reduces to `1` in consumer goals. If instead the field is relaxed to `0 < g n n` (see the other finding), the factors become live and the statements stand as written.
findings.issue: `norm : g n n = 1` (line 80) makes `Real.sqrt (g F.n F.n) = 1`, but the dead factor is baked into the whole characteristic API: `energy_apply` (93) `= g p F.n / √(g F.n F.n)`; `@[simp] energy_n` (98) `= √(g F.n F.n)`, a RHS no simp lemma reduces; `spatial_apply` (114) `p - (g p F.n / g F.n F.n) • F.n`; `energy_div_smul_add_spatial` (119) divides the energy by `√(g F.n F.n)`. Every consumer must clear these by hand, and the decomposition lemma — the elimination principle for `spatial` — is the worst hit.

findings.evidence: Line 80 `norm : g n n = 1` is the only field constraint and `Frame.mk` the only constructor; roadmap README:393 "A `Frame g` is a vector `n : V` with `0 < g n n`" and Suggested.lean:111 `timelike : 0 < g n n`.
findings.fix: Either restore the roadmap's field `timelike : 0 < g n n`, or add the smart constructor `Frame.ofTimelike {n : V} (h : 0 < g n n) : Frame g := ⟨(Real.sqrt (g n n))⁻¹ • n, _⟩` with `@[simp] ofTimelike_n`. Also fix the Main-definitions line 36, which advertises `Frame g` as "a timelike reference vector" without the unit constraint the structure actually imposes.
findings.issue: `Frame` is only constructible from an already unit-normalised `n`; there is no introduction form taking a physically given timelike vector. The roadmap's frame is `0 < g n n` (README §1.1 line 393, Suggested.lean:111), and `BreitFrame … extends Frame g` (Suggested.lean:125) must produce a frame from `K`-derived vectors, so each consumer has to redo the `(√(g n n))⁻¹ • n` normalisation and its `g n' n' = 1` proof.

summary: With the committed field `norm : g n n = 1`, every exposed statement still carries a `Real.sqrt (g F.n F.n)` or `/ g F.n F.n` factor that is identically 1, so the characteristic lemmas are not in normal form and no simp lemma reduces `g F.n F.n`. The structure also offers no introduction form for a non-unit timelike vector, which §1.2's `BreitFrame extends Frame g` will need.
